content:
Day 7 of the giant Amazon Black Friday sale is now underway, and it’s time to take a look at some of the deals you score on accessories for your Apple gear. Amazon’s wild deal on AirPods Pro 3 is still flying at $100 off, but we are also tracking some brilliant prices on even more affordable add-on gear, from AirTag 2 at the $18 Prime shipped all-time low and the lowest price of the year on the iPhone Duo-ready Apple Pencil (USB-C) at $49, right over to rare deals on Apple Magic Mouse from $59 and the official Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max at 25% off.

Those deals join some seriously notable third-party offers on the popular new Twelve South AirFly Drive Wireless CarPlay Adapter has dropped to the $32 Amazon all-time low, loads of the latest Anker chargers at the best prices ever, Beats cables, and some great Logitech offers for your at-home Mac workstation. Check it all out below.

Apple accessory deals

  • AirPods Pro 3
  • Apple Polishing Cloth
  • AirTag 2
  • Apple 40W Dynamic Power adapter
  • Apple Pencil USB-C
  • Apple Magic Mouse
  • Logitech MX Master 3S
  • Official Apple iPhone 18 Pro cases
  • Twelve South AirFly Drive Wireless CarPlay Adapter
  • Twelve South Valet leather charging trays
  • Beats USB-C Cables
  • Anker chargers and hubs
  • Logitech Mac accessories
  • Qi2.2 25W wireless chargers
  • More of the best Black Friday Week Apple deals:

AirPods Pro 3

As we have discussed previously, it’s hard to call the world’s greatest earbuds an accessory, but they are (not) arguably also the world’s greatest accessory for iPhone, Mac, iPad, and almost everything else in life. They also happen to be sitting at a bananas $100 off right now – you can literally score then for the same price as the entry-level AirPods 5:

  • AirPods Pro 3 $149 (Reg. $249) – $100 off!
  • AirPods Max 2 $419 (Reg. $549) – Now even lower at $130 off
  • Beats 360 Wireless Over-Ear Headphones $249 (Reg. $349) – All-time low

This one is very much not sale, and probably never will be, but it is now back in-stock at just $9 Prime shipped – about the half the price of the previous-gen model – and everyone knows it is the only way to properly clean your iPhone, MacBook, and Apple Watch. It is the perfect Apple stocking stuffer (not compatible with Android devices).

AirTag 2

AirTag 2 released this year at the same $29 list as the previous model, just with better range, a louder speaker, and more secure experience overall. It also happens to now be sitting down at the $18 Prime shipped all-time low for Black Friday.

  • Single AirTag 2 $18 (Reg. $29) – All-time low

Apple says its 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max is the ideal charger for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo, but it’s also great for a countless number of other tech gadgets. This one carries a $39 list price and is now sitting down at $29 Prime shipped with over 25% I savings at the ready.

  • Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max $29 (Reg. $39)

Apple Pencil USB-C

Apple Pencil USB-C is not only the most versatile model in the lineup with support for just about any even relatively modern iPad with a USB-C port, it is also the only model that works with the new iPhone Duo – it has easily been the most popular official Apple accessory over the last month or so and is now sitting at the best price of the year.

  • Apple Pencil (USB-C)$49 (Reg. $79)

Apple Magic Mouse

Apple’s Magic gear is rarely on sale, and the latest USB-C Magic Mouse in both the classic silver/white livery and the black model are now sitting at some of the best prices ever for Black Friday.

  • Magic Mouse White $60 (Reg. $79)
  • Magic Mouse Black $80 (Reg. $99)

Logitech’s MX Master 3S is also seeing a notable Black Friday discount, dropping to a new all-time low of $72.19 shipped. That’s the best price we’ve tracked for this popular productivity mouse, which is still worth considering even with the newer MX Master 4 now available. It packs an 8,000 DPI sensor, quiet clicks, MagSpeed scrolling, customizable buttons, and multi-device connectivity. You miss out on some of the latest model’s features, including haptic feedback, but the 3S still offers most of what makes the MX Master lineup great, and today’s discount makes it an even better buy.

  • Logitech MX Master 3S $72 (Reg. $100)

There are loads of the official Apple iPhone 18 Pro cases sitting down at all-time low prices right now with as much as 40% in savings. This includes the Silicone MagSafe models, the latest TechWoven colors, and the clear cases starting from $29.

  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro/Max Silicone Case from $29 (Up to 40% off)
  • Apple iPhone 18 Pro/Max TechWoven Case from $44 (Up to 25% off)

Compatible with a gigantic list of vehicles, the new and super popular Twelve South AirFly Drive Wireless CarPlay Adapter has dropped to the $32 Amazon all-time low for Black Friday. Designed to “ turn your car’s factory-wired CarPlay or Android Auto fully wireless,” there’s finally an affordable solution out there from a trusted Apple accessory brand and it is now at its best price ever.

  • Twelve South AirFly Drive Wireless CarPlay Adapter $32 (Reg. $40)

I’ve really grown to love having one of these around the house. The Twelve South Valet works in just about any room and with any decor setup – it is a truly gorgeous piece of functional tech furniture, and now at Black Friday all-time lows.

  • Twelve South Valet 4.25-inch, Taupe/Ecru: $110 (Reg. $130)
  • Twelve South Valet 7.5-inch, Taupe/Ecru: $153 (Reg. $180)
  • Twelve South Valet 7.5-inch, Black/Black: $153 (Reg. $180)

Beats USB-C Cables

Still easily some of the best in the game if you ask me, the Beats cables are like (basically are) official Apple cables, but with your choice of color and at some seriously notable prices – some of them are up to 60% off right now and start from just $7 a pop:

  • Beats 5-foot 60W Woven USB-C Cable, 2-pack $14 (Reg. $35)
  • Beats 10-foot 240W Woven USB-C Cable $18 (Reg. $30)

Anker’s official Amazon storefront has rolled out a fresh wave of Black Friday Week deals, with some particularly notable price drops on its latest charging accessories. The sale covers a wide range of gear, including USB-C GaN chargers, power banks, travel adapters, hubs, and more, with even some of the newer releases now down to their lowest prices yet. Among the highlights are its new Smart Display MagStand and the Qi2.2 25W MagGo 2 Pro power bank with a built-in cooling fan.

  • Anker’s all-new MagStand 25W Qi2.2 Charging Station $90 (Reg. $116)
  • Anker MagGo 2 Pro Qi2.2 25W 10,000mAh power bank $86 (Reg. $110)
  • Anker Nano Neo 45W/60W dynamic charger $16 (Reg. $26)
  • Anker 100W Universal Smart Display charger $60 (Reg. $80)
  • Anker 10-in-1 USB-C Smart Display hub $75 (Reg. $100)
  • Anker Nano 13-in-1 dock with detachable 6-in-1 hub $100 (Reg. $150)
  • Anker Prime 25W 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Station $128 (Reg. $230)
  • And even more…

Logitech has also dropped prices on a bunch of its Mac accessories for Black Friday Week, including the MX Master 3S wireless mouse, which is now down to $72 all-time low. The latest MX Master 4 is also on sale right now, alongside deals on the MX Creative 9-key console and other accessories including keyboards, webcams, and so on.

  • Logitech MX Master 4 $105 (Reg. $120) – Amazon low
  • Logitech MX Creative 9-key Console $152 (Reg. $200)
  • Logitech Alto Keys K98M Keyboard $90 (Reg. $120)
  • Logitech MX Keys S Mac Wireless Keyboard $103 (Reg. $130)
  • Logitech Wave Keys Ergonomic Wireless Keyboard $55 (Reg. $70)
  • Logitech Lift for Mac Vertical Wireless Mouse $60 (Reg. $70)
  • Logitech Ergo M575S Wireless Trackball Mouse $38 (Reg. $50)
  • And even more…

Brands like Anker, UGREEN, Belkin, and more have dropped prices on their newer 25W charging accessories, with deals covering everything from simple magnetic charging stands to versatile 3-in-1 stations and power banks with active cooling.
